retainedEarlierEvidence.meaning: Existing frontend-to-unchanged-backend integration evidence, not new backend or Dashboard functionality.

coverageLimits: Live legacy evaluation routes return 404; their unchanged backend implementation is absent. Fixture form checks are not live evaluation acceptance.
No usable third-party OAuth/connector credentials or non-SQLite database resources; external authorization/sync and those engines remain unverified.
Full Falcon benchmark jobs, real mobile devices and every destructive CRUD variant are outside this bounded regression.
Local mean-pooled roberta embeddings prove the functional retrieval path, not semantic retrieval quality.
No browser comparison on the old toolchain; source comparison alone does not establish upgrade causality.
Fixture network failures are fatal except ERR_ABORTED navigation cancellations. Live console null means it was not collected by that helper.
